title: The gold farmers and bots are out of control

posts.cooked: I have tried all 3 layers in the last hour in nagrand… EVERY single cloud has 3-4 people standing at it by the time it gets extracted. you can tell the bots by the fact they will come in and dismount even if its actively being extracted. They then stand still for exactly the time the channel would last, then mount and fly to the next spawn point. You can report them 100x a day and they will still be there 24/7 until the end of time… Blizzard is pathetic… If the rules don’t matter then we should all be able to just do anything we want, say anything we want, and just be as toxic as we want!
